descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-02 Patient List Capture · S20 「扫描界面上的视觉车道：axe、手机宽度和 WebKit」 Visual lane on the scan screens: axe, phone width and WebKit

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 A screenshot or photo of a patient list, sent for capture, adds the patients to the list automatically via OCR, with no manual re-typing.（UAT TC-02；TFA-92580 AC 2；TFA-92580 How it works 2-3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa
  • U3 Manual '+' entry (Add New Patient page) works on its own and produces a patient that behaves exactly like a scanned one.（UAT TC-02；TFA-92580 AC 3；TFA-92580 How it works 6） — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa
  • U4 When a day-2 scan overlaps day 1, the app shows 'N patients are already on your list' with an 'add only the new ones' option. …（UAT TC-02；TFA-92580 AC 5；TFA-92580 How it works 4） — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa
  • U9 Runs and passes in both contexts: the Hospital capture (camera icon) and the Nursing Home 'Scan Resident List' (3.3).（UAT 3.3；TFA-92580 How it works 1） — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa

测试设计方法：无障碍（accessibility） — 按读屏、键盘、对比度、点按尺寸的规则（axe）查，残障用户也要能用。

Given Fresh physician, both contexts; visual-lane profiles desktop Chromium, Pixel 7 (Chromium) and iPhone 15 (WebKit)

When The visual lane opens the scan sheet empty and with a 10-row result, both duplicate-review dialogs, /rounding/add and /snf/add in each profile, and runs axe plus the covered, overflow and tap-size checks

Then No WCAG 2 A/AA violations; the camera/scan buttons, row checkboxes and duplicate choices have accessible names. 'Take Photo or Choose Image', the row checkboxes and the Add button are visible, at least 44 pt, and not covered by the bottom navigation. Nothing overflows sideways

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：axe-core: zero serious or critical violations (visual-checks.ts). Visual-lane checks for covered, overflow and tap size. Screenshots are evidence for a person

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看）；矩阵里排的车道 视觉 / 移动端（automated）

S20 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-02.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
